he.text: סְלָחָה אֲדֹנָי הַקְשִׁיבָה וַעֲשֵׂה אַל־תְּאַחַר לְמַעֲנָךְ אֱלֹהַי כִּי־שִׁמְךָ נִקְרָא עַל־עִירְךָ וְעַל־עַמֶּךָ׃

en.text: Lord! hear: O Lord! pardon: O Lord! be graciously attentive, and grant our request: delay not for thine own sake, O my God! for thy city and thy people are called by thy name.
